claim_boundary: This source records local, non-normative semantic-closure requirements for B01. It cannot accept an ADR, change the wire contract, prove parser independence, authorize promotion or release, grant runtime authority, or satisfy external evidence gates.

questions.statement: Can an open question weaken the simulation and plant session separation or its fail-closed lineage rules?
questions.resolution: No. The proposed decision fixes separate session kinds, authority domains, and lineage retirement.

questions.statement: Which exact stable-core files and projection profile can enter the post-acceptance contract identity?
Does production ingress require a process-isolated direct-capability handoff in addition to authenticated fail-closed admission?
questions.resolution: A-direct can use one same-process opaque receiver-owned capability. A separate terminator must use an authenticated protected handoff or B-over-A.

questions.statement: Can an unknown or default observer value grant access, enrollment, currentness, or revocation success?
questions.resolution: No. Unknown and default observer values deny before grant, enrollment, or state mutation.

questions.resolution: The result is RETAINED_DISPOSITION, RETIRED_DISPOSITION_COMMITMENT, or QUERY_FAILURE with EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE, all bound to the exact query coordinate.

questions.statement: Which finite journal capacities and implementation names realize the closed disposition lifecycle?
How do extension object limits and digest spelling conform to the universal JSON frame limit and one canonical content address?
questions.resolution: The outer extension transport is a bounded raw chunk frame under one prepared activation context. One reserved slot orders chunk retention, cuts, digest verification, schema reservation, and at-most-once callback entry. The reassembled package uses a separate bounded parser profile.
